Marketing Analytics Intern (Summer 2027)
Lumen & Pine Co. – Austin, TX
About Us
Lumen & Pine is a fictional outdoor goods retailer with 40 stores across Texas.
What You'll Do
- Build weekly dashboards in Tableau to track campaign performance
- Analyze customer data with SQL and Excel
- Support social media marketing and email marketing campaigns
- Run A/B testing on landing pages with the web team
Requirements
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics, or a related field
- Experience with SQL and Microsoft Excel (pivot tables)
- Strong communication skills
- Familiarity with Google Analytics is a plus
- Must be authorized to work in the United States
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis
- Knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO)
- HubSpot or Salesforce experience
Benefits
- $22/hour, hybrid schedule (3 days per week in our Austin office)
Lumen & Pine is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability or veteran status.
